question: Outline item 16(a): are the seven workbook items with no clip absent from our copy of EU-Emotion, or only from the clip list?
method: The seven items were found locally by rerunning the human_entropy.py match of eu_emotions_oreilly_item_level.xlsx against study3/data/eu_emotions_full_manifest.json (249 items, 242 matched, 7 without a clip). Every video file in the six EU-Emotion trees on the cluster (study2/data/eu_emotions, eu_emotions_118, eu_emotions_raw, eu_emotions_voices; study3/data/eu_emotions, eu_emotions_full) was then parsed with parse_stimulus_code and matched on actor letter and item number, with the emotion checked against the file path. Item IDs and paths are kept out of this record until the licence is settled; they are in the private scratch output on the cluster.
manifest_edition_filter: edited (all 243 clips come from EDITED folders)
reading: All seven are in our copy, but only as unedited originals in the packs' Original folders; none has an edited cut. The clip list takes edited files only, so it leaves them out. For one item, an edited cut exists for a different take of the same actor and item, not for the take the workbook names. Whether the distributed set has edited cuts of these seven cannot be told from our copy.
consequence: None for the frozen designs, which use the 243 edited clips. The unedited originals differ in trimming and are not substituted.
